checks.csv: Selected node identity/coordinate bijection; finite required primitives and inside support required; units/basis lineage; explicitly bounded audited RZ axis transformation, no zero/nearest-neighbor filling
checks.field_cache: Raw axis regularity checked before sampling; the production prepared field sampler locates values/gradients; independent partition/quadrature remains the cache-error certification owner
checks.electric: Reduced static RZ P1 scope; explicit closure floors and regularized ion direction; temperatureV→K conversion; all non-axis perimeter conditions and per-component anchors checked; no native material/floating equivalence inferred
checks.output_context: Geometry-only SI/chart/source table-kind/boundary/contact/periodic interpretation context; canonical logical/file hashes bind it to run parent identities; source-ID order preserved
checks.analysis: Exact cohort intersection; computational count/model-weight denominator named; terminal outcomes distinct from first material hits; periodic transfers excluded from wall-hit statistics; deposition counts stuck once and excludes hold; incomplete ledgers gated
checks.visualization: Context chart/units used offline; valid/finite masks; periodic saved chords broken; no unsaved bounce/continuous stochastic path inferred

seed_probe_scope: Seed is actually bound by case_file_hash; the stored resume identity has no separate seed field. This probe tests canonical identity-content hashing after identity.seed is added, matching the requested regression, not a guarantee of every optional run.json annotation.
limits: Source metadata is a caller's declared physical/frame authority, not automatic native-equivalence evidence.
Generic electrical output does not automatically regenerate case-specific prescribed charge/ion/DEP coefficients; the case producer owns dependent-field coherence.
Reduced field builder is not full materials/floating/RF/circuit/plasma transport.
Saved chords are not continuous Brownian trajectories or axis first-passage paths.
model_weight is not an inferred physical flux/concentration or validated adhesion model.
Segment schema/shape validation is not a new full-value hash guarantee for all saved numerical payload bytes.
No heavy campaign/full suite/performance rerun was performed in this independent review.
